globalDrop.entryTitle: Drop into the launchpad to start
globalDrop.entryDesc: Video, audio, subtitles, scripts. Drop anywhere in the launchpad content area.
globalDrop.title: Release to import files
globalDrop.desc: Files will be saved as a draft. Choose a workflow next.
globalDrop.recipeDesc: Files will use this workflow. Complete any missing setup first.
globalDrop.unsupported: No supported video, audio, subtitle or script files found
globalDrop.subtitleRequired: This workflow accepts subtitle files only. Drop audio or video into the launchpad background or onto a transcription task card.
globalDrop.existingDescription: Adding files keeps the existing goals, recipe and settings. Starting a new task replaces the existing draft.
globalDrop.unreadableDescription: The existing draft could not be read. Its original data is preserved. Cancel to retry later, or explicitly replace it with a new task.
globalDrop.storageFailed: The draft could not be saved to disk. Installation and navigation have not started. Retry saving; existing draft data will not be silently removed.

quickDownload.title: Speech Model Required
quickDownload.desc: Saved {{count}} file(s) and task settings. Install Whisper Base (~140MB, about 15s on a fast connection; actual time depends on your network).
quickDownload.installComplete: Model installed! Navigating to your task…
quickDownload.busy: Another model is downloading. Please try again later.
quickDownload.failed: Installation failed. Check your connection or switch download sources and retry. Your draft is preserved.
quickDownload.notInstalled: Base is not installed yet. Please retry. Your draft is preserved.
